title: ClearArrested - Actor
content:
Member of: Actor Script

Clears this actor's arrested state.

Syntax:
Function ClearArrested() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
None.

Examples:
; Make the criminal no longer be arrested
Criminal.ClearArrested()
